# events

Scheduled logical events. Event payloads are not completed bank outcomes.

Read this collection using `search_records(resource="events", filters={}, cursor=0, limit=20)` or `get_record(resource="events", record_id="<returned id>")`.

**Filters:** exact scalar equality; in, contains, gte and lte operator objects on supported top-level fields. See DB-query-syntax for type and null behavior.

Search returns selected summary fields, so omission from a summary is not proof of absence from the complete record. Read detail before interpreting an optional field. Fields depend on the record type and processing stage; null and absent fields are not zero amounts. Types below describe public record shapes, rather than mandatory properties on every row.

## Fields

| Field | Observed public types | Search use | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `amount_minor` | integer | Top-level filter | Amount in integer minor currency units. Whether it denotes an instruction, liability or posted movement depends on this record type. |
| `business_area` | string | Top-level filter | Business area: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `commercial_reference` | string | Top-level filter | Reference supplied by a commercial source; use the source and period when matching evidence. |
| `due_minute` | integer | Top-level filter | Due minute: logical minute or duration, as indicated by the field name; compare with get_clock and the applicable event/validity terms. |
| `event_category` | string | Top-level filter | Event category: public attribute of this record type. The associated service article defines its operational use. |
| `id` | string | Top-level filter | Opaque record key used by get_record; obtain it from returned records or explicit references. It is not an amount, date or proof of business identity. |
| `kind` | string | Top-level filter | Record or service type. Fields and meanings can differ between kinds. Public values represented here: `actual_collections_event`, `authority_event`, `billing_event`, `card_reconciliation_event`, `certificate_event`, `consolidation_event`, `contingent_net_event`, `continuous_guarantees_event`, `credit_event`, `dated_collateral_event`, `debit_event`, `desk_account_return`, `desk_advice`, `desk_attempt_receipt`, `desk_batch_settlement`, `desk_bill_accept`, `desk_bill_debit`, `desk_billing_move`, `desk_dispute_settle`, `desk_dispute_window`, `desk_document_available`, `desk_fx_revision`, `desk_fx_settle`, `desk_mandate_effective`, `desk_mandate_revision`, `desk_message_ack`, `desk_onboarding_review`, `desk_profile_revision`, `desk_rail_test`, `desk_rail_validation`, `desk_refund_receipt`, `desk_reserve_assessment`, `desk_restriction_release`, `desk_right_release`, `desk_sender_revision`, `desk_service_stop`, `desk_tax_cutoff`, `desk_tax_post`, `discount_credit_event`, `distribution_event`, `entitlement_event`, `escrow_event`, `expense_event`, `factoring_event`, `forward_event`, `handling_event`, `insurance_event`, `interest_event`, `license_event`, `loan_servicing_event`, `maturing_refund_reserves_event`, `netting_event`, `origin_currency_refunds_event`, `overlapping_remedies_event`, `payment_acquirer_batch_close_event`, `payment_authentication_binding_event`, `payment_cheque_stop_and_replacement_event`, `payment_cross_calendar_delivery_event`, `payment_group_purchase_commitment_event`, `payment_installment_return_event`, `payment_marketplace_split_refund_event`, `payment_split_capture_event`, `payment_stored_value_restitution_event`, `payment_subscription_proration_event`, `payroll_event`, `period_coverage_event`, `revised_tolerances_event`, `sync_event`, `tiered_deposit_calendar_event`, `title_window_event`, `trade_source_receipt`, `windowed_payment_recovery_event`. This list describes the documented records, not an input-validation enum. |
| `name` | string | Top-level filter | Human-readable name. Names need not be unique; exact filters are case-sensitive. |
| `reference` | string | Top-level filter | Business reference on this object; its uniqueness depends on the issuer, entity and period. |
| `scope` | string | Top-level filter | Access namespace for the record. It is not a customer name or a universal case_id. |
| `status` | string | Top-level filter | Current state of this particular object. A proposal or submission state is distinct from a posted payment or completed review. Public values represented here: `COMPLETED`, `SCHEDULED`. This list describes the documented records, not an input-validation enum. |
| `target_id` | string | Top-level filter | Target id: opaque identifier reference. Its target depends on the containing record/operation; do not infer a collection merely by pluralizing the field name. Explicit joins are listed separately. |
